query_descriptions.cx_q09: Six-table join with a composite partsupp key and profit by nation/year
query_descriptions.cx_q13: Left outer join and nested aggregation, including zero-order customers
query_descriptions.cx_semi_anti: Correlated EXISTS/NOT EXISTS with nested semi and anti joins
query_descriptions.cx_window: Two customer windows over 1994–1995 orders and top three per customer
query_descriptions.cx_distinct: Four-table join with three exact distinct counts for 1995 orders
query_descriptions.cx_self_join: 1994 lineitem equijoin with a residual line-number inequality

cache_policy: preheated filesystem; no application dataframe cache
timing_scope: query construction, optimization, parquet read, execution, result collection; excludes session/table setup and plan serialization
host_result_timing_scope: same start as seconds, through conversion to a list of Python dictionaries; excludes normalization, plan serialization, sampler shutdown and cleanup
